solute_type.description: Type of solute added to the solvent.

solvent_type.description: Type of solvent used for dissolution.

solute_mass.description: Mass of solute added to the solvent.

solvent_volume.description: Volume of solvent available for dissolving the solute.

stirring_speed.description: Speed of stirring applied to the solution.

time_of_mixing.description: Total duration for which the solution is mixed.

saturation_level.description: Maximum saturation level allowed for the solute.

impurity_level.description: Percentage of impurities present in the solute.

pressure.description: Pressure of the environment affecting solubility.

agitation_mode.description: Method used to agitate the solution.
